Use case: compositing and style-transfer.
Asset: single wide cover illustration for a formal university partnership proposal.
Input 1: source photograph of a real candidate interview with blue table, formal candidates and staff. Input 2: source photograph of a classroom visit with adult Nepalese learners seated at desks.
Primary request: create one continuous editorial panoramic composition showing the two observed activities, interview on the left and classroom on the right, joined by softly simplified room shapes and off-white negative space. Reinterpret these actual photographed scenes as an illustration, retain people and clothing character, blue furniture and pale classroom surfaces. Do not add stages or conclusions that are absent in the photos. This is a conceptual cover scene grounded in actual photos, not a claimed outcome. Refined editorial illustration for a formal Korean university partnership proposal. Clean vector-like outlines, softly simplified natural faces, restrained gouache texture, realistic anatomy, substantial calm detail. Palette: Jeongwoo navy #0F2E54, brand blue #174EA6, cyan #069EEA, warm off-white #F5F2EB, muted charcoal, natural skin colors. A wide rectangular illustration with approximate 2.5:1 aspect ratio, no enclosing frame, no text, no logos, no watermark, no chart or certificate. Keep key people complete and avoid heads or hands clipped at the edge. Use reference photos as factual visual source, preserve visible activities, plausible room and furniture, clothing and diversity, respectful adult subjects. Simplify any actual written signs to unlettered shapes. No invented university acceptance, visa, job, credential, government endorsement or celebratory diploma imagery. White or warm off-white edges that fit an A4 document.
